newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - April 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - April 25.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- Front page editorial hails troop reduction treaty among China, Russia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan
- Premier Li Peng urges Xinhua Bookstores to make more contributions to spiritual civilisation
- China issues new rules on overseas project financing
- Wang Qishan, governor of China Construction Bank, says blind competition among banks brings risk
- China to hold 3rd national agriculture exhibition in October in Bejing
- State Commodity Inspection Bureau and customs to tighten assessment of value of foreign investment
- China aims at annual growth of 15 percent in exports of electrical and mechanical products in 1996-2000
- Editorial urges listed firms to focus on their core business
- China unhappy with Clinton-Dalai Lama meeting
- Ministry of Labour sets deadline to implement five-day work week
- Anti-drugs campaign intensifies with arrests nationwide
